integrity: The proof is analytic, identifies the imported positive absolute norm-attainment characterization, and does not claim outside verification or independent audit.
scientific_limitations: The exact distance and existence criterion concern positive absolutely norm-attaining approximants only, without uniqueness claims or classification of nonpositive nearest operators. Unindexed equivalent best-approximation results remain a residual literature risk.
title: Exact distance and nearest-point criterion for positive absolutely norm-attaining operators
